questions.prompt: When testing coolant, which should you determine first?
options: Either, the order does not matter
The coolant conditioner concentration, then the antifreeze concentration
The antifreeze concentration, then the coolant conditioner concentration
questions.explanation: The course says to determine the antifreeze concentration before testing the coolant conditioner concentration.

questions.prompt: What tool can be used to check antifreeze concentration from a drop of coolant?
options: A coolant tester (refractometer) with a sight glass
questions.explanation: A drop of coolant on the tester's glass gives a reading for antifreeze concentration.

questions.prompt: When should the radiator cap be tested?
questions.explanation: Test the radiator cap during routine cooling system maintenance.

questions.prompt: When should you check oil pressure on the gauge?
options: Only when a warning light shows
Every time you start the engine
questions.explanation: Check oil pressure every time the engine is started.

questions.prompt: How often should oil level be checked?
questions.explanation: Check oil level daily to monitor oil consumption.

questions.prompt: What happens if too much oil is added to the engine?
options: Oil can be blown out of the seals
questions.explanation: Overfilling can blow oil out of the seals.

questions.prompt: Why should you rely on visual inspection of the air filter rather than only the indicator?
options: Visual checks are required by law
The indicator can be reset at any time, so a restriction may exist even if it reads normal
questions.explanation: Because the indicator can be reset, inspect the filter itself for clogging.

questions.prompt: Which test checks whether enough air is entering the intake manifold?
questions.explanation: A boost pressure test shows whether enough air reaches the intake manifold.

questions.prompt: What do smoke tests measure?
options: How thoroughly the engine is burning fuel
questions.explanation: Smoke tests show how completely the fuel is being burned.

questions.prompt: What information do dynamic timing measurements give?
options: Injection timing for all cylinders while the engine runs
questions.explanation: Dynamic timing gives fuel injection information for all cylinders.

questions.prompt: If you adjust timing advance start, what else must you adjust?
questions.explanation: If timing advance start is adjusted, timing advance stop must also be adjusted.

questions.prompt: What is pin timing?
options: Physically aligning engine components with metal pins
questions.explanation: Pin timing aligns components mechanically with timing pins.

questions.prompt: What should be done with fuel nozzles that do not open, or open at the wrong pressure?
questions.explanation: Nozzles that fail to open at the correct pressure should be replaced.

questions.prompt: Why should you never use compressed air to clean dirt off your clothes or skin?
options: The pressure can force oil and dirt into the skin and eyes
questions.explanation: Compressed air can drive oil and particles into skin and eyes.

questions.prompt: Why should rings be removed before mechanical work?
options: They can catch in moving parts and short-circuit electrical connections
questions.explanation: Rings can get caught in moving parts and short across electrical terminals.

questions.prompt: Why must NO SMOKING areas be observed around batteries?
options: A cigarette could ignite hydrogen gas fumes and cause an explosion
It is only a company rule
questions.explanation: Batteries give off hydrogen, which can be ignited by a cigarette.

questions.prompt: Which of these should be done before starting service work?
options: Run the engine to warm it
Disconnect batteries and turn isolator switches OFF, and put warning tags on the engine and in the cab
Leave the battery connected for diagnostics
questions.explanation: Disconnecting batteries and tagging prevents accidental starts and shorts.

questions.prompt: How should you check a high pressure fuel line for leaks?
options: Never with your bare hand; use a board or cardboard
With the engine at high idle and gloves off
questions.explanation: Never use a bare hand on high pressure fuel lines; fuel can penetrate the skin.

questions.prompt: When using lifting equipment, which is correct?
options: Attach chains at a wide angle
The rated capacity must be higher than the load and the hoist operated slowly
questions.explanation: Make sure capacity exceeds the load, keep chains near perpendicular, hooks facing out, and hoist slowly.

questions.prompt: Most service procedures should be done on...
questions.explanation: Almost all service procedures should be done on a cool engine.

questions.prompt: What is the arrangement number on the information plate used for?
options: With the serial number, to access the Cat parts and ordering system
questions.explanation: The six digit arrangement number is used with the serial number for parts ordering.

questions.prompt: If one belt in a matched set is worn, what should you do?
options: Replace all the belts in the set
questions.explanation: If one belt is worn, replace the whole set.

questions.prompt: What is the goal of a visual inspection?
options: To spot problems before they become failures
questions.explanation: Visual inspection aims to catch problems before they cause failures.

questions.prompt: What should you do if you find large quantities of metal in a cut-open oil filter?
options: Fit a new filter and carry on
Contact your supervisor, as it indicates abnormal wear or a pending failure
questions.explanation: Large amounts of metal point to abnormal wear or a pending failure.

questions.prompt: What can excessive coolant conditioner cause?
options: Silica dropout that turns coolant into a gel and blocks passages
questions.explanation: Too much conditioner creates silica dropout, which can block coolant passages.

questions.prompt: On some marine engines, what must be checked during cooling maintenance?
questions.explanation: Zinc rods reduce corrosion in marine cooling systems and must be checked.

questions.prompt: Before changing fuel filters, what should be drained?
options: Water from the water separator and fuel tanks
questions.explanation: Drain water from the separator and tanks, then change the primary and final filters.

questions.prompt: How often should an S·O·S oil sample be collected?
questions.explanation: An S·O·S sample should be collected at every oil change.

questions.prompt: What can wear analysis in an S·O·S report reveal?
questions.explanation: Wear analysis shows components wearing faster than normal, before they fail.

questions.prompt: What do the chemical and physical tests in an S·O·S detect?
options: Water, fuel and coolant in the oil
questions.explanation: Chemical and physical tests detect water, fuel and coolant contamination.
